name: Fitchburg, Leominster & Princeton
state_or_region: Massachusetts (Fitchburg, Townsend, Westminster, Leominster & Princeton — with Pearl Hill, Willard Brook, Crow Hills & Wachusett Mountain)
agency: MA DCR, Mass Audubon, USGS 3DEP & OpenStreetMap Contributors
summary: Rolling hemlock and pine woods, brooks and ponds north of Fitchburg: Pearl Hill, Table Rock, Trap Falls and a dense web of shared hiking and mountain-bike trails, linked by the Midstate Trail to Leominster State Forest, the Crow Hill Ledges and the town of Princeton, with Wachusett Mountain and Wachusett Meadow.
